weekly.summary: On days you finished a to-do before work, you were more likely to clear the whole day. You finished the most around 7 AM and kept up with work almost every day. Workouts often slipped midweek, though.

tips.workout: Put your workout right after your 7 AM to-do so it slips less.
tips.midweek: Midweek, try keeping it to four to-dos or fewer.

monthly.summary: The earlier you started with a to-do, the more you got done that day. You finished the most around 7 AM, kept up with work steadily, and kept weekends light. Workouts had the lowest completion rate.

tips.repeat: Make your workout a repeating to-do with a set day and time.
tips.morning: Next month, try finishing one work to-do first thing in the morning.
